parameters.name: num_periods
parameters.description: Number of planning periods in set $\mathcal{T}$

parameters.name: processing_time
parameters.description: Processing hours required on process r for one unit of product p

parameters.name: unit_profit
parameters.description: Unit profit of product p in period t

parameters.name: regular_capacity
parameters.description: Regular available hours of process r in period t

parameters.name: minimum_production
parameters.description: Minimum required production of product p in period t

parameters.name: profit_target
parameters.description: Minimum required total profit in period t

parameters.name: process_time_target
parameters.description: Required utilization target for process r in period t

parameters.name: overtime_availability
parameters.description: Overtime availability or maximum overtime hours for process r in period t when applicable

variables.name: production_quantity
variables.description: Quantity of product p produced in period t

variables.name: regular_process_usage
variables.description: Regular hours assigned to process r in period t

variables.name: overtime_hours
variables.description: Overtime hours assigned to process r in period t where overtime is allowed

variables.name: profit_shortfall
variables.description: Nonnegative deviation variable for shortfall from the profit target in period t

variables.name: profit_excess
variables.description: Nonnegative deviation variable for excess above the profit target in period t

variables.name: minimum_production_shortfall
variables.description: Nonnegative deviation variable for shortfall from the minimum production target for product p in period t

variables.name: minimum_production_excess
variables.description: Nonnegative deviation variable for excess above the minimum production target for product p in period t

variables.name: process_time_shortfall
variables.description: Nonnegative deviation variable for shortfall from the process utilization target for process r in period t

variables.name: process_time_excess
variables.description: Nonnegative deviation variable for excess above the process utilization target for process r in period t

variables.name: total_profit
variables.description: Scalar achieved total profit over all periods

constraints.name: nonnegative_overtime_hours
constraints.description: Overtime hour allocations are nonnegative when overtime is allowed

constraints.name: nonnegative_goal_deviations
constraints.description: Deviation variables in the goal-programming representation are nonnegative

constraints.name: minimum_production_requirement
constraints.description: Each product must meet its minimum required production in every period

constraints.name: profit_target_requirement
constraints.description: Total profit in each period must meet the required target

constraints.name: process_i_exact_utilization
constraints.description: Process I must use exactly its target operating time in each period

constraints.name: process_ii_regular_capacity_utilization
constraints.description: Process II must be fully utilized at its regular capacity in each period

constraints.name: process_time_feasibility
constraints.description: Selected production must be feasible with respect to the process-time requirements implied by the product mix and the available regular and overtime hours

constraints.name: overtime_limit_respected
constraints.description: Overtime hours cannot exceed the permitted overtime availability for each process and period when overtime is allowed

constraints.name: overtime_disabled_when_not_allowed
constraints.description: Overtime variables are zero for processes and periods where overtime is not permitted

constraints.name: production_process_time_balance
constraints.description: For each process and period, total processing time required by the production plan equals regular usage plus overtime hours.

constraints.name: total_profit_definition
constraints.description: Define total profit as the sum of unit profit times production across all products and periods.

constraints.name: profit_goal_balance
constraints.description: Link achieved profit to the period profit target using positive and negative deviation variables in the goal-programming representation.

constraints.name: minimum_production_goal_balance
constraints.description: Link production quantity to the minimum production target using positive and negative deviation variables in the goal-programming representation.

constraints.name: regular_usage_capacity_limit
constraints.description: Regular process usage cannot exceed the regular capacity available in each period.

constraints.name: overtime_nonnegativity_with_permissions
constraints.description: Overtime hours are nonnegative and therefore implicitly zero when disallowed by the availability flag.

objectives.name: total_profit_maximization
objectives.description: Maximize total profit over the planning horizon while satisfying production and utilization requirements

objectives.name: goal_programming_deviation_minimization
objectives.description: Minimize deviation penalties for profit targets, minimum production targets, and process utilization targets in a goal-programming formulation

final_objective.description: Minimize total goal-programming deviations first, then maximize total profit as a secondary lexicographic criterion.
